title: Neutrino Universe Field Theory: Axiomatic System and Emergent Gravity
summary: This study proposes a unified axiomatic system of emergent gravity and cosmology based on the three-state phase transitions of a single neutral quantum field Phi. This paper specifically addresses the geometric framework established in Paper 2: a single living child universe bubble tangentially invading a Dead Universe Fluid Background.
